arguments.recommended_next_step: Analyze the failed_jobs table to identify the root cause of job failures and implement solutions to prevent future backlogs.
arguments.summary: Investigated several issues including incorrect DNS lookups, certificate expirations, and cron job scheduling. The root cause of the 502s on the checkout page was an ingress idle timeout. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database will be addressed by exporting the table for further analysis.
